periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axis is oriented vertically with a convergent tilt toward the nasal midline.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated teardrop shape where the vertical length is approximately double the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Notable downward tapering; the inferior margin extends significantly below the centroid of the patch.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Substantial thickness at the lateral junctions, covering nearly the entire shoulder height in the frontal view.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The inter-pinna distance is roughly equivalent to the width of one pinna across the cranial crown.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Symmetrically rounded convex curvature at the superior margins.
